comments.author: Achmed Khammas
comments.html: A very good translation. And a exciting, thrilling story. I startet reading at breakfast – and now (3 o’clock at night) I’m through. Thanks a lot! I hope they will translate the other two books soon…

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Hi Achmed.
Thank you for the comment. I was a bit concerned about the quality of the translation based upon the early reviews posted on the Amazon.de website. If you could post a rating that would be great. By the way, if you would like to sign up for my free Beta early reader program, I’ll be happy to add you to my list of readers for my unpublished rough drafts. If so email me at [email removed] . Thanks again.
Best,
Richard
